topic: Delhi Metro Magenta Line driverless trains
hook: Your Delhi Metro train can run with no driver.
title: Delhi's Metro Line With No Driver
description:
Delhi Metro's Magenta Line runs driverless trains. With no driver's cabin, passengers can stand at the front window and watch the tunnel rush toward them. It runs from Janakpuri West to Botanical Garden.

#Shorts #DelhiMetro #Technology
